root_cause_one_sentence: capability_gate._route_capability returned the FIRST capability of the goal's SEQUENCE composition that the route had already reached -- NAVIGATE_TO_MAP, composition index 0, reached on every cycle -- instead of the first one it had never reached, so every KEEP_MARCHES_PRODUCTIVE no-progress wall was filed against a navigation capability that is already LIVE_VERIFIED and the development agent was handed a wall with no live symptom to reproduce.

measured_before_the_fix.why_that_is_wrong: the last verified step of the stalled route was SUBMIT_RESOURCE_SEARCH (FIND_RESOURCE_NODE); the route had never reached OPEN_MARCH_FORMATION, DISPATCH_GATHER_MARCH or VERIFY_GATHERING.  Naming NAVIGATE_TO_MAP sends the next development agent to a capability whose live episodes are all verifier_ok, which is exactly the shape of an escalation that cannot be acted on.

escalation_ledger_row.dispatch_reason: max_concurrent_jobs=1 is already used by 0440cd38; two agents must not edit this repository at once
escalation_ledger_row.note: this is the escalation's OWN failure (it never reached the bridge and sat pending 5.0 min until the consumer re-offered it) and it is a separate fact from the mis-attributed capability above; it self-resolved when 0440cd38 was cancelled on its 45-minute timebox.

the_fix.winter_agent_v2/capability_gate.py::_rou: for a SEQUENCE composition it now returns the FRONTIER -- the first capability in composition order that the route has not reached; an ANY_OF composition keeps the old first-reached behaviour, because any reached alternative is genuinely a path the goal is driven along.
the_fix.winter_agent_v2/capability_gate.py::_no_: unchanged: it already carried the capability on the Deferral row and keeps the three positional fields <capability>|<failure_type>|<skill>.
the_fix.tests/test_capability_gate.py: test_a_sequence_goal_is_named_by_the_step_it_never_reached pins the frontier rule with the measured shape.

recomputed_after_the_fix.note: AVOID_STAMINA_WASTE is ANY_OF and keeps the capability the earlier escalation already used, so the change is confined to the SEQUENCE case it was measured on.

corroboration_from_the_coverage_table.why_it_matters: the capability the old rule named is the only STABLE one in the goal; every step past it is DEGRADED.  The mis-attribution therefore pointed the development agent at the one link that was not broken, which is independent confirmation of the root cause and makes OPEN_MARCH_FORMATION a defensible next target.

The step's execution block records executed=true, dry_run=false, action=TAP_SEMANTIC/PAGE_MAP, backend=ADB.

unproven: The next wall behind this one is now named OPEN_MARCH_FORMATION for KEEP_MARCHES_PRODUCTIVE, but that name has NOT been driven to a live fix: no development job has yet been dispatched against it and no live episode proves the grab-march step is where the goal stops advancing.  What is proven is only that the escalated name was wrong.

The KEEP_MARCHES_PRODUCTIVE streak itself is still unexplained: three production episodes passed their verifier and advanced no part of the goal (goal_progress false, stamina 457 unchanged in the beast case).  This job did not measure why the gather route fails to move the goal; it measured only which capability the deferral should have named.

The escalation's dispatch failure (max_concurrent_jobs=1 held by 0440cd38 for its whole 45-minute timebox) is not fixed by this change -- it self-resolved when that job was cancelled.  A single slot means a queued escalation waits for the running job's full timebox; whether that wait should be shortened was not decided here.
